prompt:
Goal: Hero banner for the GitHub profile README of soydachi, following the soydachi.com governed-paper design guideline.
Asset kind: github profile README header banner.
Subject: Warm cream paper stock with visible fiber texture, one solid amber rectangular block pressed into the surface like letterpress, two charcoal ink hairline rules near the edges, subtle paper emboss. A builder's business card printed on good warm paper. No text of any kind..
Composition: Wide horizontal 3:1 band, flat top-down view, amber block off-center left third, quiet paper space right two-thirds, even soft daylight, clean straight edges.
Art direction: editorial, minimal, letterpress print, analog paper photography.
Brand tokens: paper #f5f1e8, ink #272727, amber #f9be4a, warm floor #ece3d1.
Must include: paper fiber texture, one solid amber block as the only chroma, charcoal hairline rules, no text, no letters, no numbers.
Avoid: text, letters, logos, watermarks, dark background, gradient decoration, screenshots, devices, people.
Additional constraints: Light warm ground so it reads correctly on GitHub light mode; a dark #272727 variant can be generated later for a <picture> pair. Amber is a block, never a line or glow..
